# CWE-798: Generic secret — high-entropy value bound to secret.
# "secret=..." with 32+ random chars is likely a real secret. The rule
# flags it; ok is "changeme" or low-entropy descriptions.
# ruleid: detected-generic-secret
secret=1234567890123456789012345678901234567890
# ruleid: detected-generic-secret
SECRET: "AbCdEfGhIjKlMnOpQrStUvWxYz1234567890ABCD"
# ok: detected-generic-secret
secret = "changeme"
# ok: detected-generic-secret
description = "not a secret"
# ruleid: detected-generic-secret
secret=ZyXwVuTsRqPoNmLkJiHgFeDcBa0987654321ABCD
# ruleid: detected-generic-secret
SECRET: "QwErTyUiOpAsDfGhJkLzXcVbNm1234567890ABCD"
# ok: detected-generic-secret
description = "this is just a description not a secret"
